description: Adolf K. Weismann is sharing a peaceful meal with his loved ones, while Misaki Yata is having a blast hanging out with his HOMRA buddies. Elsewhere, Seri Awashima is working diligently to carry out her duties as SCEPTER 4, and Sukuna Gojo runs across the battlefield to fulfill the dream of JUNGLE. But as the days go by, something starts to feel off about the events that are going on in this world and the people bound to it.
